definitions.explanation: A reading of 0° — most commonly 0°C (the freezing point of water), but also 0° in angle measurement. Often used in weather and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}の{気温|きおん}は{零度|れいど}だった。
examples.english: This morning's temperature was zero degrees.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}は{零度|れいど}で{凍|こお}る。
{今夜|こんや}は{零度|れいど}を{下回|したまわ}る{予想|よそう}なので、{道路|どうろ}が{凍|こお}るかもしれない。
examples.english: Tonight is forecast to drop below zero degrees, so the roads may freeze.

notes:
Composed of {零|れい} (zero) + {度|ど} (degree). Default reference is Celsius; specify with {摂氏|せっし}{零度|れいど} or {華氏|かし}{零度|れいど} if needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零度|れいど}{以下|いか}: below zero
- {零度|れいど}を{下回|したまわ}る: to drop below zero
- {零度|れいど}に{達|たっ}する: to reach zero degrees
- {氷点下|ひょうてんか}: sub-zero (literally 'below freezing point')

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {氷点|ひょうてん}: freezing point — refers to the point at which water freezes, often used in {氷点下|ひょうてんか}
- マイナス: minus / negative — マイナス{五度|ごど} = minus five degrees, very common in weather speech
